intro.sr: Posetilac se prijavljuje na newsletter kroz formu u podnožju (email, interesovanje, pristanak), administrator vidi pretplatnika sa oblašću i izvorom, a pretplatnik se na kraju odjavljuje linkom iz mejla.
intro.en: A visitor subscribes through the footer form (email, interest, consent), an administrator sees the subscriber with area and source, and the subscriber finally unsubscribes through the link in the email.

newsletter-forma.sr: Na dnu svake stranice je forma za prijavu na newsletter.
newsletter-forma.en: At the bottom of every page there is a newsletter sign-up form.

newsletter-interesovanje.sr: Bira šta ga zanima, pa dobija samo te poruke.
newsletter-interesovanje.en: They choose what interests them and only get those messages.

newsletter-pristanak.sr: Pristanak mora da se označi sam; bez njega prijava nije moguća, a vreme pristanka se čuva kao dokaz.
newsletter-pristanak.en: Consent has to be ticked explicitly; without it sign-up is impossible, and the time of consent is stored as proof.

newsletter-slanje.sr: {Kliknemo} „Prijavi se“. Stranica potvrđuje prijavu, a stiže i poruka dobrodošlice.
newsletter-slanje.en: We {click} “Prijavi se”. The page confirms the sign-up and a welcome message follows.

admin-newsletter-otvara-meni.en: We open the “Sadržaj i marketing” group.

admin-newsletter-pretraga.en: We find the subscriber by email.

admin-newsletter-pregled.sr: Nova prijava je odmah tu, sa statusom i vremenom prijave. Odjava je za posetioca jedan klik iz svakog mejla.
admin-newsletter-pregled.en: The new sign-up is there at once, with status and time. For the visitor, unsubscribing is one click from every email.

admin-newsletter-oblast-izvor.sr: Tabela ima dve kolone koje razlikuju pretplatnike: „Oblast“ (usluge, tretmani i paketi, kozmetika i proizvodi ili b2b/partnerstvo) i „Izvor“ (footer sajta, točak sreće, API ili admin), uz stranicu sa koje je prijava stigla. Tako se zna ko traži tretmane, a ko saradnju, i koji deo sistema donosi pretplatnike.
admin-newsletter-oblast-izvor.en: The table has two columns that tell subscribers apart: “Oblast” (services, treatments and packages, cosmetics and products, or b2b/partnership) and “Izvor” (site footer, wheel of fortune, API or admin), together with the page the signup came from. This shows who wants treatments and who wants a partnership, and which part of the system brings subscribers.

admin-newsletter-filteri.sr: Filteri po oblasti i izvoru izdvajaju grupu kojoj se piše. Kampanja se istim redom bira po oblasti, pa B2B ponuda ne stiže onima koji žele samo tretmane.
admin-newsletter-filteri.en: Filters by area and source pick out the group to write to. A campaign is chosen by area in the same way, so a B2B offer does not reach those who only want treatments.

newsletter-odjava-link.sr: Svaki newsletter u dnu ima link za odjavu. Pretplatnik ga otvara i odmah se odjavljuje, bez prijave i bez dodatnih koraka.
newsletter-odjava-link.en: Every newsletter has an unsubscribe link at the bottom. The subscriber opens it and is unsubscribed immediately, with no sign-in and no extra steps.

newsletter-odjava-potvrda.sr: Prikazuje se jasna potvrda da je odjava uspela. Ako je link star ili pogrešan, stranica to kaže i nudi kontakt, pa niko ne ostaje u nedoumici.
newsletter-odjava-potvrda.en: A clear confirmation that the unsubscribe worked is shown. If the link is old or wrong, the page says so and offers a contact, so nobody is left wondering.
